Settings.SyncEnabledHint: Sends resource events to the Nimrod session log panel.
Settings.NimrodUrlHint: Base URL of your Nimrod site (e.g. https://nimrod.mysite.com). No trailing slash.
Settings.NimrodTokenHint: JWT token of the GM Principal. Copy from the Nimrod panel → Settings → API Token.
Settings.ActiveSessionIdHint: UUID of the session open in the Nimrod panel. Copy when opening a session. Changing this value clears the sent-event cache.
Settings.OnlyPlayerOwnedHint: Ignores NPCs and tokens with no owner. Recommended to keep enabled.
Settings.TrackHpHint: Logs HP gain and loss. May generate many events during combat.
Settings.TrackItemsHint: Logs when an item is added to or removed from a character's inventory.
